real_work.description: The engineering runtime declares authority and provenance for its own context sources: constitution (policy://engineering/v1) and project (profile://engineering/candidate) as directive/config/trusted, protected-criteria as data/config/untrusted, each with the sha256 digest of its exact content. Real tasks now emit context.assembled v2 with sources[]. The production change in tools/cli/lib/engineering-task-runtime.js was written by the model through one governed patch; tests, docs and this receipt were prepared by the executor.
real_work.prompt_nature: PRESCRIPTIVE: the prompt states the design (local helper in the resolver, exact provenance fields, the crypto call, no conditionals) and gives the exact block to replace. The dispatch proves the governed route (contract, scoped patch, protected verifier, ledger), NOT the ability of the model to design the solution.
